rationale: The current best family is still the compact reverse-tail recurrent path, while recent anchor-refresh variants regressed badly. This run keeps the proven structure but splits the late-tail curriculum into two compile-stable schedules: the carry path turns on earlier and with a higher floor than the recurrent block update, so the model can learn to reuse the decoder-output anchor before paying the full recurrent transform cost. That is a real structural change, stays compact, preserves exact final int8+zlib evaluation, and directly targets the recurrent-tail/export regime that produced the local wins.
title: Dual Carry/Update Tail Curriculum
